blocks.text:
Performatively is an Android app made by a friend of Folio, and Folio is happy to point to it.

Get opens its page on Google Play. Folio does not install it for you, does not change it, and shares nothing with it: the Play Store tells you who made it and what it asks for before anything is installed.

items: Installed by Android, not by Folio
Nothing is shared with the app when you tap Get
